name: What's the difference between repairing a leaky shower faucet and a leaky shower drain?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between repairing a leaky shower faucet and a leaky shower drain?

acceptedAnswer.text: Repairing a leaky shower faucet typically involves addressing internal components like cartridges, O-rings, or washers within the faucet body that control water flow. A leaky shower drain, however, usually involves issues with the drain seal, the P-trap, or cracks in the drain assembly itself, which can lead to water escaping into the subfloor. Each requires a different diagnostic approach and set of repair techniques to ensure water tightness. Our technicians are equipped to handle both types of leaks efficiently.
acceptedAnswer.description: Faucet leaks are internal component issues; drain leaks involve the drain seal or assembly. Each requires different repair methods.
